reflexium.title: Reflexium
reflexium.option.reflex_mode.tooltip:
Lowers input latency by letting the driver start each frame just in time for the GPU.

On + Boost also keeps GPU clocks high when the CPU is the bottleneck.
reflexium.option.frame_limiter.tooltip: While Reflex is on, enforce Max Framerate with the Reflex sleep instead of vanilla's limiter. Lower latency at the same cap.
reflexium.option.dlss_detection.tooltip: Enables the Vulkan extensions DLSS needs on Minecraft's device. Applies after a restart.
reflexium.option.status.tooltip: Shows the live Reflex, DLSS and shader loader status.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.reflexium: NVIDIA Reflex, DLSS and AMD FSR 3.1 for Minecraft's Vulkan renderer.
reflexium.option.upscaler.tooltip:
Renders the world below display resolution, then reconstructs detail. The HUD stays at full resolution.

Auto uses DLSS when available, otherwise FSR 3.1. FSR works on compatible AMD, Intel, and NVIDIA GPUs. Windows x64 and Vulkan required.

Temporal upscaling is experimental. Moving objects can leave trails. Paused while a Vitrail shader pack draws.
reflexium.option.quality.tooltip:
Quality prioritizes detail. Performance and Ultra Performance lower the internal resolution to improve GPU performance.

Native AA keeps full resolution and uses temporal anti-aliasing (DLAA with DLSS). Has no effect when upscaling is Off.
reflexium.option.dlss_model.tooltip:
Auto uses the NVIDIA runtime defaults. Transformer requests preset K for improved temporal stability. CNN requests the legacy preset E, which can be faster on older RTX GPUs.

Only affects DLSS. The installed NVIDIA runtime and driver overrides determine preset support.
reflexium.option.fsr_sharpness.tooltip: Additional sharpening after FSR upscaling. 0% disables sharpening. Only affects FSR.
